更多。

祢将力量如赠与般倾倒。我们感受到了。我们会成长……绝不止步。
texts.en:
more.

you pour your power into us like an offering. we feel it. we grow... do not stop.

texts.zh:
又来。一样的浪费，一样的结果。

我把你们所消耗的还给了你们，不是为了伤害你们，而是让你们感受到它的分量。事不过三。我不想看到你们再一次浪费自我。
texts.en:
Again. The same waste, the same result.

I return what you spent, not to hurt you, but so you feel the weight of it. Learn from this. I will not watch you spend yourself a third time.

label.zh: 这是我们需要学习的一课。
label.en: The lesson is ours to carry.

texts.zh:
你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……

真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。
texts.en:
You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...

Such a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.

label.zh: 她对我们有更好的期望。

# 火控改写 / Fire Control Overridden

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:17264-17440; common/scripted_effects/nomads_effects.txt (dyson_gun_firing); common/on_actions/02_component_on_actions.txt:404 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

方舟舰的戴森炮开火时（on_dyson_shoot → nomads.8000，dyson_gun_firing），若目标星系里有特殊对象，玩家收到对应窗口。

When an arkship's Dyson gun fires (on_dyson_shoot -> nomads.8000, dyson_gun_firing), a player gets a window if the target system holds a special target.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

瞄准“AI帝国”（ai_empire）拥有的人工智能星球：火控被改写8050；射向异次元的维度传送门：力量反被对方吸收8055；射向塞塔娜的女王泰坦：首次为“失望”8060，再次则“反上一课”8065（她把耗费的资源还给我方）。

Aiming at an AI world owned by an ai_empire country: fire control is overridden (8050); at the extradimensional portal: the power is absorbed instead (8055); at Cetana's titan: A Disappointment (8060) the first time, A Lesson Returned (8065) when repeated (she returns what was spent).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

四个窗口互斥，均只有一个回答。

The four windows are exclusive, each with a single reply.
